paragraphs.en: It’s no surprise that Jennifer Senior’s insightful, provocative magazine cover story, “I love My Children, I Hate My Life, ” is arousing much chatter – nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience. Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition. Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that “the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.”
paragraphs.zh: 詹妮弗·西尼尔那篇见解深刻、发人深省的杂志封面文章《我爱我的孩子，我讨厌我的生活》引发了广泛讨论，这并不令人意外。没有什么比提出“养育孩子并非完全令人满足、丰富人生的经历”更能引起人们的议论。西尼尔没有得出孩子会使父母幸福或痛苦的结论，而是提出我们需要重新定义幸福：与其把幸福看成可以用每一刻的快乐来衡量的东西，不如把它视为一种回望过去时的状态。西尼尔写道，尽管日复一日地养育孩子可能艰难到令人心力交瘁，但“恰恰是那些当时让我们心情低落的事情，日后可能成为强烈满足感和喜悦的来源”。

paragraphs.en: The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week. There are also stories about newly adoptive – and newly single – mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual “Jennifer Aniston is pregnant” news. Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
paragraphs.zh: 那张漂亮母亲怀抱可爱婴儿的杂志封面，绝不是本周报刊亭里唯一的圣母子式画面。还有一些报道讲述桑德拉·布洛克——她刚收养孩子，也刚恢复单身——以及惯常的“詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了”之类的消息。几乎每周，报刊亭里都至少会有一位面带微笑的明星妈妈或准妈妈。

paragraphs.en: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing? It doesn’t seem quite fair, then, to compare the regrets of parents to the regrets of the childless. Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn’t have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个如此执着地赞颂生育的社会里，承认自己后悔生孩子，就相当于承认自己支持杀害小猫，这又有什么可奇怪的呢？因此，把父母的后悔与无子女者的后悔相比较，似乎并不十分公平。不幸福的父母很少受到外界刺激，去思考自己是不是不该生孩子；但不幸福的无子女者却不断受到一种说法的困扰：孩子是世界上最重要的东西，所以他们的痛苦显然必定直接源于人生中那个缺少孩子的巨大空洞。

paragraphs.en: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock. According to several studies concluding that parents are less happy than childless couples, single parents are the least happy of all. No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their “own” (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，《美国周刊》和《人物》等明星杂志所展现的为人父母的形象，极不现实，尤其当父母是布洛克这样的单身母亲时。多项研究得出结论，有孩子的父母不如无子女夫妇幸福，而单亲父母是其中最不幸福的。想想没有伴侣可以依靠，养育一个孩子需要付出多少辛劳，这一点毫不奇怪；可按照桑德拉和布兰妮的说法，“独自”养育孩子——意思是有人全天候帮忙——简直轻而易举。

paragraphs.en: It’s hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut. But it’s interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren’t in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting “the Rachel” might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
paragraphs.zh: 很难想象，会有很多人愚蠢到仅仅因为瑞茜和安吉丽娜把生儿育女展现得如此光彩照人，就也想要孩子：大多数成年人都明白，生孩子可不是换个发型。不过，一个值得玩味的问题是：我们每周看到的那些毫无压力、增添幸福的育儿画面，会不会以某种细微而不自觉的方式，加深了我们对真实育儿经历的不满？这就像我们心底曾有那么一点希望，觉得剪一个“瑞秋式”发型，或许能让自己看起来稍微像一点詹妮弗·安妮斯顿。
